Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect give 1 on my Digimon  even when my opponent has no Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if they have no unsuspended Digimon, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Angoramon] in its text, it gets +2000 DP.
